annotation.authors_or_issuer: Civil Aviation Safety Authority (Australia); Department of Infrastructure, Transport, Regional Development, Communications, Sport and the Arts
key_provisions_or_claims: Exempts specified remotely piloted aircraft operations beyond visual line of sight from certain CASR requirements
Made under the Civil Aviation Safety Regulations 1998
Registered 27 August 2024 on the Federal Register of Legislation (F2024L01057)
Instrument is scheduled to cease/sunset on 31 August 2026
annotation.summary_en: Federal Register of Legislation page for CASA EX51/24, an Australian exemption instrument made under the Civil Aviation Safety Regulations 1998. It permits certain remotely piloted aircraft operations beyond visual line of sight, registered 27 August 2024 and ceasing 31 August 2026. Only metadata is shown, not the full text.
